players.product: QCT single-molecule NGS (smNGS) prenatal (UNITY) and oncology (Northstar) cell-free DNA tests with proprietary algorithms

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release (8-K Exhibit 99.1), first-half figures: six-month revenue was $217.8 million versus $125.5 million (+74%), with prenatal $190.8 million (+63%), oncology $24.4 million (+242%) and clinical trial support and other services $2.7 million (+81%). Tests delivered were 384,000 in the first half (+40%) and overall ASP $561 (+25%); in Q2, total tests accessioned were 197,000 versus 148,000 (+33%). First-half adjusted EBITDA was $42,166 thousand and free cash flow $16,046 thousand (Q2 adjusted EBITDA $16,143 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue $217.8 million (+74%); oncology $24.4 million (+242%); 384,000 tests delivered (+40%); ASP $561; Q2 197,000 tests accessioned
